name: Gold Multi-EMA Trend Pullback with VWAP Anchor

rules.entry_long: Pullback to EMA21 in uptrend (EMA9 > EMA21 > EMA50), candle closes back above EMA21, confirm with VWAP (price > VWAP)
rules.entry_short: Pullback to EMA21 in downtrend (EMA9 < EMA21 < EMA50), candle closes back below EMA21, confirm with VWAP (price < VWAP)
rules.target: Trail behind EMA9 or fixed R-multiples (2R, 3R)

notes: Multi-timeframe: Daily 50/200 for regime, H1 21/50 for trend, M5/M15 9/21 for entry. VWAP as intraday anchor.

name: EMA 9 / VWAP Crossover with ATR Trailing Stop
notes: Bias defined by EMA vs VWAP relationship. ATR trailing locks profits.

name: Regime-Filtered Gold: VWAP + EMA50 Pullback + EMA50 Trail

rules.entry_long: Pullback to EMA50 (price touches EMA50), rejection candle closes back above EMA50, price > VWAP
rules.entry_short: Rally to EMA50 (price touches EMA50), rejection candle closes back below EMA50, price < VWAP
rules.stop: ATR-adjusted position sizing (1% risk), hard SL at 1.5×ATR beyond EMA50
rules.trail: EMA50 as dynamic trailing stop (activated on candle close only, not intrabar)
rules.news_filter: No trades ±1 hour of major US data (CPI, NFP, FOMC, ISM)

notes: Paper reports: 247 trades, 45.3% WR, PF 1.76, Sharpe 3.99, Max DD 5.1% (Jan-Dec 2024). Machine-testable rules.

name: Gold EMA/BB/VWAP Crossover with ATR SL/TP

rules.entry_long: Fast EMA crosses above BB midline AND price > Slow EMA AND price > VWAP AND session/weekday allowed
rules.entry_short: Fast EMA crosses below BB midline AND price < Slow EMA AND price < VWAP AND session/weekday allowed

notes: Non-repainting, close-bar confirmation. Multiple session filters.

name: VWAP Rotation Pivot: Zero-Lag EMA65 / Session VWAP + Pivot R2/S2

rules.momentum_long: ZLEMA65 crosses above session VWAP AND both rising
rules.momentum_short: ZLEMA65 crosses below session VWAP AND both falling
rules.pivot_rotation_long: Momentum long hits R2 -> close momentum, open bounce short if averages point down
rules.pivot_rotation_short: Momentum short hits S2 -> close momentum, open bounce long if averages point up
rules.ema_stop_line: Momentum trades close if price crosses back through EMA50

notes: No martingale/grid. Closed-bar signals. Pivot rotation adds mean-reversion layer.

name: Anchored VWAP / EMA9 Bias-Gated Entries

rules.entry_long: Bullish bias active AND price closes above EMA9
rules.entry_short: Bearish bias active AND price closes below EMA9
rules.bias_flip_exit: If Price/EMA signals disabled, VWAP/EMA crossover arms Exit X directly

notes: Bias-gated entries prevent counter-trend trades. Works any symbol/timeframe.

name: EMA 9/21 + VWAP Slope Filter (French)

rules.entry_long: EMA9 crosses above VWAP AND EMA9 > EMA21 AND VWAP has clear directional slope (not flat)
rules.entry_short: EMA9 crosses below VWAP AND EMA9 < EMA21 AND VWAP has clear directional slope (not flat)
rules.exit: Opposite crossover or VWAP slope flattens

notes: Smart filter avoids ranging VWAP. Designed for 5-15min charts.

name: VWAP 9 EMA Cross with 1 ATR Stop (Backtested)

parameters.cross_rule: R2 (first cross only, hold to session end)

rules.entry_long: EMA9 crosses above VWAP, candle closes above both, enter next candle open
rules.entry_short: EMA9 crosses below VWAP, candle closes below both, enter next candle open
rules.stop: 1 ATR below VWAP (long) / 1 ATR above VWAP (short)
rules.exit: Session end (16:00 NY / 17:30 Berlin) OR opposite cross (R1 variant)
rules.variant_r2: First cross only, hold to session end

notes: Backtested: DAX 15m +215% (both periods), NQ 15m +23%. Gold/forex failed. Costs eat ~2/3 of gross edge.

name: Golden Cross 50/200 SMA with 3 ATR Stop

rules.entry_long: SMA50 crosses above SMA200 (golden cross), enter next candle open
rules.entry_short: SMA50 crosses below SMA200 (death cross), enter next candle open
rules.exit: Opposite cross (death cross closes long, golden cross closes short)
rules.no_trade_after_sl: Wait for next cross after stop-out

notes: H4 results: Gold +47% PF1.52, EURUSD +39% PF1.39, GBPUSD +25% PF1.32, NQ +10% PF1.16. D1: too few trades. Gold/EURUSD/GBPUSD passed on H4.

name: GBPJPY 12 SMA / 32 SMA Band Crossover

rules.entry_long: SMA12 crosses above each of the 32 SMA (high, low, close) -> buy 1 lot each cross (3 lots total)
rules.entry_short: SMA12 crosses below each of the 32 SMA -> sell 1 lot each cross
rules.exit: Close and reverse when SMA12 crosses back (no spread cost on reverse)
rules.position_sizing: 3 lots per $3000 equity (micro lots for smaller accounts)

notes: Always 3 lots open. Reverse on cross-back saves spread. Author warns: backtesting useless due to candle-close lag.

name: Fib Pullback (38.2-78.6) + EMA 20/50 Confluence

rules.deep_zone: 61.8-78.6% fib + SMA50 confluence = conservative swing entry
rules.confirmation: Bullish/bearish engulfing or wick rejection at confluence zone
rules.stop_shallow: Below entry wick or recent swing low

notes: Confluence of Fib + MA + structure (OB, FVG, S/R) increases probability. Wait for price action confirmation.

name: VWAP 2-SD Mean Reversion with ADX Regime Filter

rules.regime_filter: ADX(14) < 25 (no strong trend), no major news ±1hr, opening range < 2× 20-day avg
rules.setup_long: Price extends to -2SD (below VWAP), rejection candle (pin bar, engulfing, volume spike)
rules.setup_short: Price extends to +2SD (above VWAP), rejection candle
rules.entry: Market order next bar open after trigger closes
rules.target: VWAP (optional: half at VWAP, trail rest to other side)

notes: Fails on strong trend days. Regime filter mandatory. Best on ES/NQ during chop.

name: US30 VWAP Trend Pullback with Hammer Trigger
session: US cash session (09:30-16:00 EST), trending days only

rules.context_long: Clear uptrend on M5, price > VWAP for most of session
rules.signal_long: Pullback to VWAP, bullish hammer/rejection candle at VWAP
rules.stop_long: Below swing low and VWAP (or 0.5-1.0 × ATR below VWAP)
rules.signal_short: Rally to VWAP, bearish rejection candle

notes: Fails in choppy/range markets. Order flow (cumulative delta) adds confirmation.

name: EMA 9/21 Multi-Timeframe Pullback (QuantLogic)

rules.entry_long: 1min low touches 1min EMA21 AND 1min close > 1min EMA21 (pullback holds)
rules.entry_short: 1min high touches 1min EMA21 AND 1min close < 1min EMA21 (rally fails)
rules.note: First pullback after trend start != late pullback; time/distance are data points

notes: QuantLogic's exact rule. Multi-timeframe: 5min for trend, 1min for precision entry.

name: Triple EMA 9/21/55 Alignment + Pullback to Medium

rules.entry_long: Price pulls back to EMA21 (medium) in aligned uptrend, enter on rejection
rules.entry_short: Price rallies to EMA21 in aligned downtrend, enter on rejection

notes: cBot for cTrader. Only enters when all 3 EMAs aligned. Pullback to medium EMA avoids chasing.

name: EMA50/SMA200 Cross -> First Pullback to EMA50 + Fib Targets

rules.setup_long: EMA50 crosses above SMA200, wait for first pullback to touch EMA50
rules.setup_short: EMA50 crosses below SMA200, wait for first rally to touch EMA50
rules.wick_rule: Wick can touch SMA200, but candle CANNOT close beyond SMA200
rules.fib_draw_long: High of retracement -> Low of retracement
rules.fib_draw_short: Low of retracement -> High of retracement
rules.invalidation: Close beyond SMA200 OR EMA/SMA cross again

notes: SL > TP initially (100 level to 0 level vs 161.8), but extensions provide large R-multiples. First pullback only.

name: Gold 5M Scalp: EMA9/21 Pullback with 15M EMA50 Filter

rules.setup_long: 5M pullback to EMA21 holds (no close below), bullish candle closes above EMA9, RSI > 40
rules.setup_short: 5M rally to EMA21 rejects (no close above), bearish candle closes below EMA9, RSI < 60
rules.vwap_reversion: In ranging: price stretches 1.5×ATR from session VWAP -> reversal candle -> target VWAP

notes: Only scalp in direction of 15M EMA50. VWAP mean reversion for range conditions.

name: VWAP Price Cross (Basic) with 1 ATR Stop

rules.entry_long: Candle closes above VWAP AND prior candle closed below VWAP -> enter next open
rules.entry_short: Candle closes below VWAP AND prior candle closed above VWAP -> enter next open
rules.stop: 1 ATR below VWAP (long) / 1 ATR above VWAP (short)

notes: DAX 15m/30m only profitable market (+215%, +108% both periods). Gold/forex failed catastrophically (-90%+). 2-hour session filter helped DAX.

name: EMA 9/21 Crossover (1H Futures) - RipBacktest Results
notes: RipBacktest: 12 variants tested, 0 passed all gates. 'Buried · No proven edge'. Gold 5M EMA20/50+200 filter also buried.

name: Lux Clara: Fast/Slow EMA Cross + VWAP Filter + Time Window

rules.entry_long: Fast EMA crosses above Slow EMA AND Slow EMA > VWAP AND within time window
rules.entry_short: Fast EMA crosses below Slow EMA AND Slow EMA < VWAP AND within time window

notes: Chinese docs. Slow EMA relative to VWAP acts as trend filter. Time window avoids low-liquidity hours.
